payload.recallText: I began my illustrious career in the Bronx as a hard-boiled reporter for the Ram, the student paper at Fordham University. The school was trying to replace working-class students with wealthier, higher class students. I go outside and approach the dean. I ask, "Dean McGowan, is it true that Fordham University is raising tuition to keep certain students out?" The dean replies "Listen up punk." Then a pie appears beside him and lands on his face. I ask "Do you have any comments about this?" The dean replies, "Yes, I have a comment. Fuck you." I go back to the student newspaper room, and Jim Dwyer, soon to be pulitizer-prize winner, asks what I'm going to write. I tell him about the dean. Jim says "Dean McGown, that guys a dick. Write it up." I begin writing up the story. As many would say is a line that shouldn't be crossed in journalism, I start making shit up. I call the attacker Pie Man. Capital "P," Capital "M." I receive a response from Pie Man, telling me where he'll strike next. I witness the next attack. Later, I'm at the bar, being asked if I know where he'll strike next. "Yes I do," I say, "Let me buy you a beer and I'll tell you all about it."
